R118 polish: haptics (light/medium/heavy/selection, persists pulse.haptics.enabled, native @capacitor/haptics + web navigator.vibrate fallback, wired to note save/delete, tab switch, mic start/stop, with Settings → Feedback toggle) and 3-slide first-launch onboarding (Local-first, Voice+AI, Markdown+[[wikilinks]], replaces R85+ flow). 331/331 vitest (+9: 6 haptics + 3 OnboardingView). P1 trio lands: backup rules exclude app_webview/ from cloud-backup and device-transfer (local-first promise); voice input via SpeechRecognition is the 8th tool in NotesView toolbar; Settings view (Profile, Theme, About, Actions) opens from a gear button in NotesView. R93b-signed (v2+v3, no v1). 304/304 vitest (+2 version-assertion tests for APP_VERSION / APP_VERSION_CODE). APK 1.29 MB, SHA-256 AD6E3302...45BAB5.

R93 bridge release (manifest chain 5 to 7); R95a re-signed with the R93b release.keystore (CN=Pulse Notes, O=Lesside) under APK Signature Scheme v2 + v3. APK is 1.35 MB (minify+shrink from R93b build config). v0.6.3 / v0.6.4 users side-load v0.6.5 directly. Users who installed the pre-R95a debug-signed v0.6.5 must uninstall first because the signing key changed.

R90: manifest URL fallback chain (fix chicken-and-egg URL rotation). UpdateChecker now tries a chain of 5 known hosts instead of a single baked-in URL, so a new deploy no longer orphans the previous APK's poll target.

In-app UpdateChecker revival (R52 lost in R73 mavis-trash + R77 reset). Polls remote manifest, surfaces M3 dialog with force-update support, SHA-256 fingerprint, release-notes link, and 24h cache TTL.
Onboarding v2 (4 screens: Welcome, Capture, Smart Engine v3, Local-first) with M3 expressive buttons, slide transitions, anti-emoji UI
Adaptive app icon (Tokyo Night blue P+spark) + M3 splash screen (no white flash, dark)
GREENFIELD: Pulse Notes markdown editor on Android (CodeMirror 6, split-pane, backlinks, tag autocomplete)
